design_notes.purpose: Map the (κ_p, κ_C) ridge first identified in S106.
design_notes.hypothesis_A: κ_C peak stable at ~0.30 across κ_phase.
design_notes.hypothesis_B: κ_C peak shifts lower at larger κ_phase.
design_notes.hypothesis_C: κ_C peak shifts higher at larger κ_phase.
design_notes.hypothesis_D: No peak at weak κ_phase=0.15 (monotone curve).
design_notes.recycle_source: S106 provides full κ_phase=0.30 slice; S105 provides κ_C=0.15 at all three κ_phase values.
